goal: Run USDT tracepoint functional tests without requiring root permissions, BCC, or matching kernel headers
Make tracepoint tests easier for developers to run locally while dropping privileged mode in CI
agreement: Substantive support for simplifying USDT testing by testing Core directly instead of BCC (0xB10C)
Questions on aarch64 compatibility and relation to broader tracing issues (0xB10C, maflcko)
Minor suggestions on CI comments and test configurations (maflcko)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because running USDT tests locally without root or kernel headers is a clear developer improvement
It eliminates heavy tracing dependencies and removes over 600 lines of test code
USDT testing remains a specialized developer workflow, so the cleanup is deferrable
